content: पैत्र {%a.%} (-त्री|{%f.%}) [पितुरिदम् अण्] .²1 Relating to a father or ancestors generally, paternal, ancestral. .²2 Sacred to the Manes. .{@-त्रम्@} .²1 The part of the hand between the forefinger and the thumb. (Also पैत्र्य in this sense.) .²2 A year, month, or day sacred to the Pitṛs.
